Variant coverage: SINGLE and DOUBLE stores are both covered across direct and mmap implementations where available.
Prefix coverage: optional key-prefix filtering visits only matching entries without sorted-by-value, composite-key, secondary-index, or materialized-result semantics.
Allocation coverage: visitor hot path avoids Consumer boxing, allocating lambdas, streams, iterators, boxed primitives, result collections, and per-record heap allocation.

assumptions: The range API belongs in the store module public surface under com.joshorig.ull.lvc.store and its direct/mmap implementations.
Range bounds are integer keys mapped through the existing store key/slot protocol and are inclusive at both endpoints.
forEach(fromKey,toKey,visitor) is the canonical ascending inclusive scan unless implemented as an alias for ascendingRange.
ascendingRange(fromKey,toKey,visitor) returns no records when fromKey is greater than toKey; descendingRange supports high-to-low traversal with inclusive endpoints.
SINGLE and DOUBLE direct and mmap stores can scan existing slots without introducing secondary index state or materialized snapshots.
Optional key-prefix filtering is primitive scan-time filtering only and does not introduce sorted-by-value queries, composite keys, secondary indexes, or materialized result semantics.
This is read/query API work only; journal, checkpoint, snapshot, CRC, stale-state, invariant-failure, and partial-acceptance recovery criteria are intentionally out of scope.
